description: A ranged, guarded download: `offset` and `length` select bytes `[offset, offset + length)`, and `ifUnchanged` makes the daemon refuse (`changed`) when the file's `size` or `mtimeMs` no longer equals the values the client saw earlier, so a resume never splices two versions of a file. `length` may be omitted to read to the end of the file; `stream` may be omitted to let the daemon pick. The answer is `file_download_response`.
